identity.name: TokenSafe OUMV adapter for PHP (Laravel + Symfony)
identity.description: Dependency-free PHP sidecar: static Laravel Route:: / Symfony #[Route] discovery, handler slicing via token_get_all, OCC mutations and php -l verification over stdio and HTTP

limitations: errorCount1m stays 0: the sidecar dispatches no requests
static scan only: prefixes are resolved from literal Route::prefix/controller groups
middleware chains are ignored and reported as empty arrays
Symfony YAML/XML route files are not parsed (attributes only)
request/response DTOs are omitted: they are not reflectable without booting the framework
handler ranges come from token_get_all(), never from line guessing
version is the sha256 of the whole file even when a window or symbol slice is returned
affected symbols come from the scanned route catalog; breakingRisk stays UNKNOWN without evidence
OCC expectedVersion is mandatory; stale tokens fail with -32001
modes: replace, create, symbol, patch, delete, rename
syntax pre-flight runs php -l on a temp copy outside the workspace
backups are written under <root>/.tokensafe/backups/, never next to the source file
verify runs the configured static command (default `php -l {file}`) against the resolved handler
requests are not dispatched: there is no live PHP application, so no HTTP status is asserted
read-only mode registers no applyEdit/previewEdit/verify/build: they answer -32601 METHOD_NOT_FOUND (spec §8.5)
the handshake advertises capabilities.readOnly and omits mutate/verify
